evidence.title: preserves deterministic Operational Query Plane reads
lowers a system-known-action fixture through the canonical ATOMIC_ACTION model
lowers atomic IR into a draft DomainAction without authority/effect/idempotency identity
never reuses the IR hash as DomainAction, Work, BusinessEffect, or idempotency identity
projects BusinessEffect only for comparison and never as an IR identity
uses a tagged identity domain that cannot masquerade as a BusinessEffect hash/idempotency key
keeps shared-types below Operational IR and prevents reverse/transitive cycles
is invariant to arbitrary JSON object insertion order
keeps semantic hash stable across provenance timestamps and ids
rejects a schema with a required artifact missing
uses the same route candidate, validates, lowers exactly, and records EQUIVALENT with zero mutations
rejects a supplemental observation used as an Effect's expected proof
has no model, provider, authority, persistence, or execution callback seam
fails a changed Operational Query request as REGRESSION
locks every required semantic category to an existing non-live test selector and exact corpus hash
